	### Compatibility
944f4dda5f784e266310978b31f65b3d452e6387 37 37
	
944f4dda5f784e266310978b31f65b3d452e6387 38 38
	Mirrors renderTagInput over renderFormContainer with data-form-type=tag-input as a fieldset: the legend reads title/label/heading/name (default Tag Input), subtitle aliases description/subtitle/hint, the Tag input named tag takes placeholder and shows value, and tags (records read label/name/role/value/id, scalars render as text) render one data-tag-item each after the input; authored children replace the generated body. The generic field lowers to tags while value is the typed text: a saved onChange binding owns a local string state in the React and Vue targets, so the input is controlled. maxTagsParameter, allowCustomParameter, allowListParameter, minLengthParameter, maxLengthParameter and synonymParameter are consumed.
